description: Server-side event requests to the Snapchat Conversions API v3 events endpoint, including the JSON event payload.

params.name: access_token
params.description: The events endpoint authenticates with an access token on the request.
params.fix_hint: Send the Conversions API access token, and keep it out of anything client-side.

params.name: event_name
params.description: Snap documents a fixed set of event types, spelled in upper case with underscores.
params.fix_hint: Use one of the documented event types, such as `PAGE_VIEW` or `PURCHASE`.

params.name: event_time
params.description: It is the epoch timestamp of the conversion, and Snap only accepts events from the last 7 days.
params.fix_hint: Send the epoch timestamp of the conversion, not of the moment you forwarded it.

params.name: action_source
params.description: It says where the event took place, and Snap accepts three values.
params.fix_hint: Use `WEB`, `OFFLINE`, or `MOBILE_APP`. Snap spells these in upper case, unlike Meta.

params.name: event_source_url
params.description: It is the URL of the page the event happened on, and Snap requires it for web events.
params.fix_hint: Send the full page URL, including the scheme.

params.name: user_data
params.description: Snap matches the conversion on customer information, and the event needs at least one identifier.
params.fix_hint: Add a `user_data` object carrying a hashed email, hashed phone, mobile ad id, or IP and user agent pair.

params.name: user_data.em
params.description: Email must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Trim and lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.em[]
params.description: Every email in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ph
params.description: Phone must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.

params.name: user_data.ph[]
params.description: Every phone number in the list must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.fn
params.description: First name must be SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.ln
params.description: Last name must be SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.zp
params.description: Postal code must be SHA-256 hashed.

params.name: user_data.client_ip_address
params.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the address of the browser rather than of your server.

params.name: user_data.client_user_agent
params.description: It is sent unhashed, and it must be the browser's user agent rather than your HTTP client's.

rules.message: The event is marked `action_source: WEB` but carries no `event_source_url`, which Snap requires for website events.
rules.fix_hint: Send the URL of the page the event took place on.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Snap requires customer information to be normalized and SHA-256 hashed.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Snap documents it as one of the parameters that is sent unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw value. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.
